variants.text: A young adult female with an oval face, medium-thickness soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with upward tilt, and a nose with a bulbous tip.

A young adult female with an oval face shape, medium soft-arched eyebrows, and almond-shaped eyes featuring a double upper-lid crease and upward canthal tilt. She has a straight nose with a bulbous tip and balanced lips with a defined cupid's bow.

A young adult female with an oval face, moderate brow ridge, and cheekbones of average fullness. She has medium-thickness soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with upward canthal tilt and double upper-lid creases. The nose has a straight dorsum and bulbous tip. Her mouth has a balanced lip fullness ratio and a short philtrum with defined ridges. There are no persistent marks visible.

This is a young woman with an oval face and bangs covering her hairline. She has medium, nicely arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes that tilt upward slightly, and a nose with a rounder tip. Her mouth has a clear cupid's bow and she has a neutral expression.
